content: 2026 consensus on Next.js vs Vite+React: Next.js default for public/SEO/content sites; Vite+React SPA recommended for authenticated/client-only apps, internal tools, embedded widgets, and prototypes. Client-only SPAs ship less framework JS (better INP on small apps); Next wins LCP via SSR but SSR irrelevant when app is fully client-side. Static export Next.js (output:'export') disables server features anyway. Migration Vite->Next later is feasible if data fetching kept separate.
